titleEn: Minimum Swaps to Arrange a Binary Grid
title: 排列二进制网格的最少交换次数
summary: 只能交换相邻两行，要求第 i 行末尾至少 n-1-i 个零，求最少交换次数或负一。
insight: 计算每行尾随零数。逐目标行 i，向下找首个满足需求的行并用相邻交换上移；选最近可行行最省且不妨碍此前位置。
pitfalls: 上移时中间行依次下移
找不到满足行立即失败

solutions.title: 最近可行行上移贪心
solutions.idea: 按从上到下的需求依次固定每一行。
steps: i 从零，need=n-1-i，找最小 row>=i 且 zeros[row]>=need
不存在返回 -1；answer+=row-i，并把该值冒泡移动到 i

code.java: class Solution { public int minSwaps(int[][] grid){int n=grid.length;int[] zeros=new int[n];for(int row=0;row<n;row++)for(int col=n-1;col>=0&&grid[row][col]==0;col--)zeros[row]++;int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int row=i,need=n-1-i;while(row<n&&zeros[row]<need)row++;if(row==n)return -1;answer+=row-i;while(row>i){int temporary=zeros[row];zeros[row]=zeros[row-1];zeros[row-1]=temporary;row--;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minSwaps(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=grid.size;val zeros=IntArray(n);for(row in 0 until n)for(col in n-1 downTo 0){if(grid[row][col]!=0)break;zeros[row]++};var answer=0;for(i in 0 until n){var row=i;val need=n-1-i;while(row<n&&zeros[row]<need)row++;if(row==n)return -1;answer+=row-i;while(row>i){val temporary=zeros[row];zeros[row]=zeros[row-1];zeros[row-1]=temporary;row--}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minSwaps(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int n=grid.size();vector<int> zeros(n);for(int row=0;row<n;++row)for(int col=n-1;col>=0&&!grid[row][col];--col)++zeros[row];int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<n;++i){int row=i,need=n-1-i;while(row<n&&zeros[row]<need)++row;if(row==n)return -1;answer+=row-i;while(row>i){swap(zeros[row],zeros[row-1]);--row;}}return answer;} };
